CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to a specific identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate for p0/current/n0 red), its presentation/access (coordinate listing), and an explicit origin/status entry for the same referent are all present.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation statement tied to a specific content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report names specific contents and attributes (e.g. p0/current/n0 red coordinate).

D.rationale: The report separately records an origin/status field for identified contents (distinguishing copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate, etc.).

O.rationale: The coordinate listing shows how the identified content is presented/represented (explicit location set for the attribute).
